narr: A stalled frontal boundary produced thunderstorms, concentrated north of Highway 70, with the greatest coverage along and north of Highway 264. Several storms became severe and produced damaging winds, large hail up to tennis ball size, and an isolated tornado.
ev: Stalled vehicles were reported due to high water along South Old Oregon Inlet Road in South Nags Head.
lsr: Stalled vehicles in high water along South Old Oregon Inlet Road in South Nags Head.
